preconditions.description: The number of lamps n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.
The list of main lamps a has exactly n - 1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list a is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and len(stdout.splitlines()[1:]) == n - 1)
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or consists of n lines, with the first line being the index of the lamp connected to the power grid and the next n - 1 lines being the wire connections.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', each of the n - 1 lines describing the wires contains exactly two integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', each wire connects two distinct lamps, each with an index between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or len(set(tuple(sorted(map(int, line.split()))) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == n - 1
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', all wire connections are unique and undirected.
If the output is not '-1', all wire connections involve distinct pairs of lamps.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) in set(map(int, stdout.splitlines()[1:]).union(set(map(int, [y for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()]])))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the lamp connected to the power grid is one of the lamps in the wire connections.
